name: booking_ref
description: Primary Key. Traveltek iSell / iBOS booking or inquiry reference (e.g. HT-884120).

name: raw_entered_hotel_text
description: Raw free-text hotel/resort string typed manually into iSell by the consultant from supplier extranet.

name: owning_department
description: Department currently owning the record: Branch_Sales, Vista_Desk, Contact_Centre, or Finance_iBOS.

name: booking_status
description: Operational state: Quote_Open, Confirmed_DD, At_Risk_Cancellation, Deferred_Audit_Flag, Vista_Ticketing.

name: booking_created_date
description: Date the inquiry or booking was logged in Traveltek iSell (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: deferral_months_shifted
description: Number of months departure date was pushed out (12 indicates Audit Genie flag for artificial bonus protection).

name: total_package_gbp
description: Total booking transaction value (TTV) in GBP.

name: expected_margin_gbp
description: Expected gross margin or commission in GBP recorded in iSell.

name: fx_sunny_spend_attached
description: Whether Hays Travel's in-house TPF Sunny Spend FX card is attached to the booking.
